verdicts.reason: A: everything is crammed into the left half and the right ~45% of the canvas is empty. The controller is jammed against the left edge, and the CTA button and FIZZBANG logo have shrunk to unreadable pills, with the can reduced to a speck beside them. B makes the same mistakes (an illegibly small CTA and logo, a vestigial can, a bottom-heavy stack that leaves the right third empty), but its headline and subcopy are larger, the controller has room to breathe, and the cluster is better centred, so it is the less broken of the two.
